additional_concerns: The constant-true result implements activation under the expressly proposed independent-footnote reading. It does not establish that this reading governs: footnote 5 can alternatively specify the minimum content of paragraph 14's request-conditioned demonstration. The supplied text does not conclusively reconcile these readings.
TRUE_IS_SATISFIED must be interpreted through this candidate's DUTY_TRIGGER question. True establishes neither completed demonstration nor substantive compliance.

Paragraph 10 and footnote 1 retain responsibility despite outsourcing; they do not supply a complete authority, supervision, outcome, severity, duration or remediation test. Proper records and operational compatibility are expressly required, but actual facts and an applicable assessment standard remain necessary.

Section 6.11C concerns third-party valuation. Its care, monitoring and review requirements cannot automatically become the general tokenisation supervision standard. Intermediary paragraphs 13 and 17–18 likewise require their own role and activity predicates; intermediary paragraph 13 is not the paragraph 13 referenced in footnote 5.

The complete referenced paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2 and applicable Appendix factors are not supplied. Their absence limits assessment of substantive compliance and demonstration content, without itself deciding the request trigger.

Paragraph 15 audit or verification and paragraph 16 legal opinion have separate request conditions. Neither is automatically activated by the proposed independent effect of footnote 5. Section 6.8's register-location notification also has its own request condition.
The supplied structural validation and retrieval results establish neither legal support nor operational fulfillment.
